definitions.explanation: An establishment that cuts hair and shaves the face, licensed under barbering ({理容|りよう}) regulations. A formal, official-sounding term; in everyday speech people more often say {床屋|とこや} or {美容院|びよういん}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{理容店|りようてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to the barbershop in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {理容店|りようてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{散髪|さんぱつ}→散髪：06318_sanpatsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{顔|かお}そり→顔そり：29566_kaosori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: At a barbershop you can get a haircut and a face shave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何十年|なんじゅうねん}→何十年：30624_nanjuunen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{理容店|りようてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather has gone to the same barbershop for decades.

notes:
A formal term for a barbershop, common on signs and in official contexts. Barbershops are licensed separately from beauty salons (⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧) and may shave customers with a razor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理容店|りようてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the barbershop
- {理容店|りようてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}む→営む：11837_itonamu⟧: to run a barbershop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{床屋|とこや}→床屋：01682_tokoya⟧: barbershop — the casual everyday word for the same place
- ⟦{理髪店|りはつてん}→理髪店：06320_rihatsuten⟧: barbershop — another formal synonym
- ⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧: beauty salon — does styling and perms; legally distinct from a barbershop
